EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Rollback Planning

Rollback Planning workflow for coding agents. Use when a migration or release needs recovery steps.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. Attach a trigger and recovery action to each risky stage; retain verification.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.

Populated example

Request: Move user IDs to UUIDs.

Keep old IDs during dual-read/write and define rollback before switching consumers.

Use the helper

rollback_plan
